inference: Multiplayer class traits, training paths and perks are unchanged in structure and stored values between 1.4.3.5 and 2.1.1.0. The Season 5 training-path revisions announced for Battle Royale do not appear in the eight multiplayer path assets.
The Flak text now states 33%, which matches the stored 0.67 explosive multiplier (1 - 0.67). The re-pointing to Affector_FlakJacket changes no value.

The Quick Plating text changed from 33% to 25% faster, but the only stored replate constant found (1.5 in both the Pointman_Base and FasterArmorReplate graphs) is unchanged. Either the text was corrected to a different reading of 1.5 (1/1.5 = 0.667 is 33% less time, not 25%), or the effective value is set elsewhere (the unidentified stat id 34 -> 35, or a registry row not named for plating). Quick Plating belongs to the Battle Royale Pointman path, not to a multiplayer slot.

The Recon class record now carries its signature trait text (AIM-SPOT) in the same fields the Assault (MISSION FOCUSED) and Engineer (MECHANIZED INFANTRY) records use; the Support record's two trait strings are still missing from the English table. The Passive Spotting perk record lost its strings in the same table change.
unresolved: UI record to gameplay asset identity remains a name match: 24 of 32 slots by internal name (one case-only), 2 by display name, 5 by text alias, 1 (Ability_ActiveUAVOverwatch) by folder name; no stored pointer exists (L840).

Which of the two UI path records per class (Breacher/Frontliner, Anti-Armor/Combat Engineer, Sniper/Spec Ops, Combat Medic/Fire Support) is FieldUpgradePath_<class>_1 or _2 is not stored; the loadout preset names MP_<class>_1/_2 carry the same titles but are not a join either.
Where the game reads the Quick Plating speed; the role of stat id 35 in call 239dc415.
Why Affector_Flak was replaced by an identical Affector_FlakJacket (a consumer other than Ability_Flak may read the old one).
siteImpact: None. No site value reads these assets. The class-trait display proposals of L861 keep their text basis; the Flak statement can now cite the in-game 33% wording.

leads.title: Class traits, training paths and perks rechecked on 2.1.1.0: UI assets, path assets and multiplayer stored values unchanged; Flak re-pointed to an identical Flak Jacket affector; four perk strings changed, Quick Plating text 33% -> 25% with the stored 1.5 unchanged
leads.summary: Four UI metadata assets and all 16 FieldUpgradePath assets are byte-identical to 1.4.3.5; of 61 byte-changed ability assets 59 differ only in compiled type indices, body hashes and a new affector header field, Ability_Flak imports the new Affector_FlakJacket (0.67 explosive, same as Affector_Flak) and the BR weapon-grant table was reordered; the English table changed Quick Plating to 25% faster (Pointman and FasterArmorReplate bodies still store 1.5 with stat id 34 -> 35), added 33% to Flak (matches 0.67), moved the AIM-SPOT trait text onto the Recon class record and dropped the Passive Spotting perk strings.
leads.reopenWhen: A stored join from UI perk records to Ability assets, a consumer that reads the Quick Plating speed (stat id 35), or a later update that changes a FieldUpgradePath_* asset or a multiplayer affector payload.
